claims.text: Macaw currently supports a command line interface, as well as mobile, desktop, and web applications, including a Telegram bot.
The Telegram interface allows multi-modal interactions such as text, speech, image, and click, and is compatible with various devices and operating systems.
Macaw's modular design allows for easy configuration and addition of new user interfaces.
